what: a mandrake: a pale, gnarled, forked root shaped like a little man, about knee-high, standing on two root legs. Its body is wrinkled pale tan root with thin hair-roots trailing from it; its head is the knobbly top of the root with a crown of broad dark green leaves sprouting from it like hair. Its face is two small dark eye-holes and a wide round screaming mouth, pitch-black inside. Its arms are thin forked roots.
colours: pale tan and cream root skin with brown wrinkles, broad dark green leaves on the head, a black mouth and black eye-holes. No pink skin, no red.
wears: It wears nothing: it is a root.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: its root arms are thrown out to both sides.
pose: Seen from the front, standing on its two forked root legs, arms flung wide, its mouth gaping open in a scream, leaves standing up on its head.
must_show: a forked root shaped like a little man
a crown of broad dark green leaves on its head

what: a kappa, the Japanese river imp: a child-sized green creature that stands on two legs like a small wrestler, with a turtle's shell on its back, a hard yellow beak for a mouth, webbed hands and feet, scaly green skin, and a bald head with a shallow round dish in the top of it holding water. Lank black hair rings the dish.
colours: scaly olive-green skin, a dark brown turtle shell, a yellow beak, black hair round a pale grey dish with clear water in it, yellow eyes. No red.
wears: It wears nothing but a short white loincloth like a sumo wrestler's.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: both webbed hands are open in front of it, ready to grapple.
pose: Seen from the front, crouching low in a sumo wrestler's stance: knees bent and wide, both webbed hands out in front, the beak open, the water-dish on its head plainly seen from slightly above.
must_show: a turtle shell on its back
a shallow dish of water on top of its bald head

what: an eloko, a small forest spirit of the Congo that is not a human being: a little creature about knee-high, its whole body thickly covered in long blades of green grass and broad leaves like a walking tuft of jungle grass, with no skin showing except its face; its face is dark green-brown and rough like tree bark, with two small glowing yellow eyes and an enormous wide mouth full of sharp white teeth.
colours: bright and dark green grass and leaves all over its body, a dark green-brown bark face, glowing yellow eyes, white teeth, one small shining brass bell.
wears: A skirt of big green leaves round its waist, nothing else.
holds: It holds exactly one small brass bell held up in its right hand, as big as its fist; its left hand is a twig-like claw, empty.
pose: Seen from the front, standing on two thin legs, leaning forward, ringing the bell held up high in its right hand, its huge grinning mouth wide open.
must_show: a small creature covered all over in long green grass and leaves
a small brass bell held up in one hand
a bark-like face with an enormous mouth of sharp white teeth

what: an asanbosam, the forest horror of the Akan: a gaunt, long-limbed creature with grey-brown skin stretched over its bones, very long thin legs, long matted black hair and a mouth of iron teeth that shine dull grey; its feet turn both ways, forward and back.
colours: grey-brown skin, long matted black hair hanging down, dull iron-grey teeth, red eyes. No green.
wears: A ragged strip of bark cloth round its hips.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: its long clawed hands reach down toward the viewer, empty.
pose: Caught in mid-air as it drops head first, upside down, its long legs bent up above it, its long arms reaching down toward the viewer, its iron-toothed mouth open, its matted hair hanging down below its head. Nothing above it and nothing below it.
must_show: long matted black hair hanging down

what: an ahuizotl, the water beast of the Aztec lakes as the friar Sahagun's informants told of it: a small dog-like animal the size of a little dog, with a dog's short blunt muzzle, small pointed ears, short smooth wet black fur, and paws that are small grey hands with fingers like a monkey's; its long thin black tail ends in a grey human hand with five fingers spread open, as big as its own head, held up high over its back.
colours: smooth wet black fur, small grey monkey-like hands for paws, a pale grey hand with five fingers at the tail tip, small yellow eyes, white teeth.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; the hand at the end of its tail is open and reaching.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, standing on four legs like a small dog, its head low and its ears back, its tail curled up high over its back with the open hand at its tip reaching forward over its head.
must_show: a small black dog-like animal on four legs
small grey hands with fingers for paws
a grey five-fingered hand at the very tip of its tail, held high

what: a khalkotauros, a bull made of bronze by Hephaestus: a massive bull on four legs built of burnished bronze plates riveted together, with seams that glow orange from the fire inside it, bronze hooves, and long curved bronze horns. Its mouth is open and a short jet of orange flame shoots from it.
colours: burnished golden-brown bronze with dark rivets, glowing orange seams, an orange and yellow flame. No green verdigris.
wears: It is a bronze machine-beast and wears nothing: no yoke, no harness.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, all four bronze hooves planted, head lowered to charge with horns forward, one short jet of flame shooting straight out of its mouth no longer than its own head.
must_show: a bull made of bronze plates and rivets
a short jet of fire from its mouth
on four legs, seen from the side

what: a cu-sith, the fairy hound of the Scottish Highlands: a huge shaggy hound on four legs as big as a young bullock, with a dark green shaggy coat, a long tail coiled up flat on its back, huge paws and pale glowing green eyes. It is a real animal of enormous size, heavy and broad.
colours: dark moss-green shaggy fur, a darker green back, pale glowing green eyes, black claws, white teeth. No blue, no grey wolf colouring, no brown.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing: no collar.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, standing on four legs, its head raised and its mouth open in a deep bark, its long tail curled up flat over its back.
must_show: a huge shaggy dark green hound on four legs
a tail coiled up on its back

what: a bulgasari, the Korean iron-eating beast: a heavy beast on four legs shaped like a bear, with no fur at all: its whole hide is dark iron-grey metal, overlapping hammered iron plates like a suit of scale armour grown on its body, with silver needles, spoons, nails and dark spear-heads sticking out of the plates all over its back. It has a short thick hanging trunk on its face, small red eyes and broad clawed paws.
colours: dark iron-grey metal hide of overlapping plates with rust-brown edges, bright silver needles and spoons, dark spear-heads, small red eyes. No fur, no brown bear colouring.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; an iron spoon dangles from its trunk.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, striding forward on four legs, its short trunk raised, its jaws open.
must_show: a heavy beast on four legs with a hide of iron plates, no fur
a short trunk on its face
needles, spoons and spear-heads sticking out of its back

what: a vetala, a spirit that lives in dead bodies: a grey, emaciated human corpse that the spirit has taken, dead flesh, corpse-grey, never living pink; its eyes glow pale green-white like two small lamps because the spirit looks out of them; wild grey hair; and a pale grey-white smoky glow rises off its head and shoulders like steam, the spirit showing round the body it wears.
colours: corpse-grey skin, eyes glowing pale green-white, wild grey hair, a pale grey-white smoky glow rising off its head and shoulders, a dirty white loincloth, a withered orange-brown marigold garland.
wears: A torn dirty white cloth round its hips and a withered marigold garland round its neck.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: both clawed hands reach forward, empty.
pose: Seen from the front, lurching forward with knees bent, arms reaching, jaw hanging open, its glowing eyes staring.
must_show: a pale smoky glow rising off its head and shoulders

what: Likho One-Eyed, the Russian hag of ill luck, a cyclops hag: a gaunt crooked old woman with grey-brown wrinkled skin, realistic adult proportions, long thin limbs, a hooked nose, long tangled grey hair and long bony fingers with black nails; she has one single huge eye in the middle of her forehead, above the bridge of her nose.
colours: grey-brown wrinkled skin, a single yellow eye with a black pupil, tangled grey hair, black rags. No green skin.
wears: Ragged black clothes hanging in strips.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: both long-fingered hands reach forward, clutching at the air.
pose: Seen exactly from the side in full profile, like a figure on a coin, facing left: her one huge eye in the middle of her forehead shows in profile at the front of her brow, her hooked nose below it, her hands reaching out to the left.
must_show: a crooked old woman seen in profile
one huge eye at the front of her forehead
action: She stalks forward, bent double, both clawed hands reaching out in front of her.

what: a nahual, a Nahua (Aztec) sorcerer half-changed into a jaguar: a lean man with realistic adult proportions, bronze-brown skin, black hair, his arms and shoulders covered in spotted jaguar fur spreading up from his hands, his hands turning into clawed paws, yellow jaguar eyes. A cloak of green and red feathers hangs from his shoulders.
colours: bronze-brown skin, golden-yellow jaguar fur with black rosettes on his arms and shoulders, a cloak of green and scarlet feathers, a black glassy obsidian knife, yellow eyes.
wears: A white cotton loincloth and a short cloak of green and scarlet feathers; a jade bead necklace.
holds: It holds exactly one short black obsidian knife no longer than his hand in his right hand; his left hand is a clawed paw, open.
pose: Seen from the front, crouching forward low as if about to spring, the obsidian knife held out in his right hand, his left paw raised with claws out, snarling.
must_show: a man whose arms are becoming spotted jaguar fur

what: a centaur of Greek legend: ONE creature, the body of a chestnut horse with four legs, but the horse has no horse's head and no horse's neck at all; where the horse's neck would be, the bare upper body of a bearded man rises straight out of the front of the horse's shoulders, joined at the man's waist, so the man's torso is the front of the horse. He has long dark hair, a dark beard and a lion-skin knotted over one shoulder.
colours: weather-beaten light tan skin, dark brown hair and beard, a tawny lion-skin, a chestnut-brown horse body, a dark brown horn bow.
wears: A tawny lion-skin knotted over one shoulder; no armour, no helmet.
holds: It holds exactly one short curved bow made of horn in his left hand held out in front, his right hand drawing an arrow back to his cheek.
action: He stands steady on all four horse legs and draws his bow at full draw, aiming to the left.
pose: Seen in full profile like a figure on a coin, facing left, the bow a single D shape at the left of the picture entirely in front of him, all four horse legs on the ground.
must_show: one creature: a man's torso growing out of a horse's body where its neck would be

what: a Blue Man of the Minch, a sea spirit of the Scottish Hebrides: a man shown from the waist up rising out of a small swirl of sea foam, with skin of deep slate-blue, a long grey face, long floating white hair and beard, and webbed hands; below his waist is only a small round swirl of white foam and dark water, which ends well inside the picture.
colours: deep slate-blue skin, white hair and beard, dark grey-blue water and white foam, pale grey eyes.
wears: Nothing but strands of brown seaweed over one shoulder.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: both hands are empty, his right raised high as he calls out, his left reaching forward with fingers spread.
pose: Rising waist-high from a churning swirl of foam, caught mid-movement, leaning forward, one hand raised high, his mouth open calling out.
must_show: blue-skinned man from the waist up
a small swirl of sea foam at his waist

what: a vila, a Serbian mountain fairy: a tall slender woman with realistic adult proportions, pale skin, very long unbound golden hair streaming in the wind, in a flowing white robe, inside a swirl of wind with leaves caught in it.
colours: pale skin, long golden hair, a white robe, a light grey whirl of wind with a few green leaves, a pale wooden bow, grey-blue eyes.
wears: A long flowing white robe and a white girdle.
holds: It holds exactly one long pale wooden bow in her left hand held out in front, her right hand drawing an arrow back.
action: She stands steady and draws her bow at full draw, aiming to the left.
pose: Seen in full profile like a figure on a coin, facing left, the bow a single D shape at the left of the picture entirely in front of her, her hair and robe streaming in the wind behind her.
must_show: a tall woman in a white robe
a swirl of wind round her

what: a gold-digging ant of Herodotus: a real ant, an insect, drawn large, golden-brown and shiny, with six legs, huge curved mandibles, bent antennae, and a fringe of coarse hair on its legs. Glittering gold sand clings to its legs and jaws.
colours: shiny golden-brown and amber body, dark brown joints, glittering gold sand, black eyes. No green, no red.
wears: It is an insect and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; a few grains of gold sand fall from its mandibles.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, standing on its six legs, its head raised and its huge mandibles wide open.
must_show: an ant with six legs seen from the side

what: a ponaturi, a goblin-like sea raider of Maori legend: a lean man-shaped creature of a small adult's height, realistic proportions, with pale sea-wet grey-green skin, webbed fingers, long dripping black seaweed-like hair, and a wide mouth of small sharp teeth. He flinches away from a light, one arm thrown up over his eyes.
colours: pale grey-green wet skin, black hair like seaweed, a bone-white club studded with shark teeth, dark eyes. No blue.
wears: A short skirt of woven dark flax.
holds: It holds exactly one short bone-white club studded with shark teeth in his right hand; his left arm is raised in front of his eyes.
pose: Seen from the front, recoiling and flinching back, his left arm thrown up over his eyes as if from a bright light, his club held low in his right hand.

what: a taniwha of Maori legend: a vast water monster shaped like a giant crocodile or a huge monitor lizard, very long and very low, its belly almost touching the ground, four short thick legs sprawled out to the sides with clawed feet, a long serpent-like body, a heavy tail as long as its body, a flat broad head with long jaws like a crocodile's, a row of short spines down its back, and dark green-black scales marked with pale spiral patterns.
colours: dark green-black scales, pale grey-green spiral markings on the scales, a pale grey-green belly, yellow eyes, white teeth, a pink-red mouth.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, crawling low with its belly near the ground and its short legs sprawled out to the sides like a crocodile's, its long jaws open wide.
must_show: a long low crocodile-like body with short sprawled legs
pale spiral markings on its scales

what: an impundulu, the lightning bird of Zulu belief: a man-sized bird of prey with black-and-white plumage, a fiery red tail and red legs, a hooked black beak, and bright yellow zigzag lightning crackling along its wings.
colours: glossy black and white feathers, a fiery red tail, red legs, a black hooked beak, bright yellow zigzag lightning, yellow eyes. No green.
wears: It is a bird and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; its red talons are open.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, stooping down in a dive with its wings raised high above its back, talons forward, beak open.

what: a mapinguari of the Amazon: a towering shaggy beast standing upright on two short thick legs like a giant ground sloth, covered in long coarse red-brown hair, with no ordinary eyes, smooth fur there; one eyeball as wide as half its face in the middle of its forehead, a second mouth full of teeth gaping in its belly, and long hooked claws on its long arms. Its feet point backward.
colours: long coarse red-brown and dark brown hair, a single yellow eye, a pink-red belly mouth with white teeth, black claws. No orange.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: its long arms hang forward with the hooked claws spread.
pose: Seen from the front, standing upright and hunched, leaning forward, its long clawed arms raised to strike, the mouth in its belly open.
must_show: a shaggy red-brown upright beast like a giant sloth
one eye in the middle of its face
a toothed mouth in its belly

what: a preta, a hungry ghost of Buddhist belief: a tall emaciated ghost, not a bare skeleton: ash-grey skin stretched tight over its bones covers it all over; its belly is enormously swollen and round like a drum, part of its own body and covered in the same ash-grey skin; its neck is as thin as a needle, its head small with a tiny round mouth with small orange flames at its lips, sunken black eyes and long thin fingers.
colours: ash-grey skin all over, the swollen belly the same ash-grey skin, small orange flames at the lips, black sunken eyes, wisps of grey hair, a torn grey rag.
wears: A torn grey rag round its hips.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: its long-fingered hands reach forward, grasping.
pose: Seen from the front, standing hunched on thin legs, leaning forward with both long arms reaching out, its huge belly hanging.
must_show: an emaciated grey ghost covered in grey skin
a huge round swollen belly of the same grey skin
tiny flames at its small mouth

what: an upas tree of Java: a tall pale-barked tropical tree with a straight trunk and spreading branches with dark green leaves, milky white sap weeping from cuts in its trunk, a few bones caught among its roots, and a faint yellow-green haze round its lower trunk.
colours: pale grey bark, dark green leaves, milky white sap, bone-white bones, a faint yellow-green haze. No blue.
holds: It is a tree and holds nothing.
pose: The whole tree shown from the top of its crown down to its roots, its roots spread at the bottom with nothing beneath them, sap dripping from its trunk.
must_show: milky white sap weeping from the trunk

what: the nuckelavee of Orkney: ONE monstrous creature, a horse with no skin, its whole body dark red raw muscle and sinew with black veins over it and no hair, and out of its back, where a rider would sit, grows the upper body of a huge man made of the same skinless dark red muscle, joined to the horse with no saddle and no legs of his own; the man's head is too big and lolls forward, his arms are so long they reach to the ground; the horse's head has one single burning orange eye.
colours: dark red sinew with black veins, a pale bone-white spine ridge, one burning orange-red eye, black hooves. No green, no bright pink.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: the rider's long arms hang down to the ground, empty.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, the horse body on four legs walking forward, the rider's torso slumped forward on top of it, long arms trailing.
must_show: one creature: a skinless horse with a skinless man's body growing from its back
dark red sinew, no skin, no hair
very long arms reaching to the ground
one burning eye in the horse's head

what: star jelly, pwdre ser: a glistening pale translucent mass of trembling jelly with faint glowing motes of starlight floating inside it, falling in mid-air with long thick dripping strands hanging from it.
colours: pale milky translucent white-blue jelly, small bright white and pale yellow motes of light inside, darker grey shadows in its folds. No green.
holds: It is a jelly and holds nothing.
pose: Caught in mid-air as it falls, its mass bulging at the bottom and long thick strands of jelly dripping from its top.

what: a psoglav of South Slavic lore, a one-eyed cyclops with the head of a hound: a hulking cave-dweller standing on two legs, with a long dog muzzle, a black dog nose and two floppy dog ears; it has ONE single large round eye glowing yellow in the middle of its forehead, just above the top of its muzzle, and there are no eyes at the sides of its head, only fur; a mouth of dull iron teeth; a man's hairy torso and arms; and the hind legs of a horse, bending backward at the hock, ending in black hooves. Coarse dark brown hair covers it.
colours: coarse dark brown hair, no orange, a single glowing yellow eye, dull iron-grey teeth, black hooves, a glowing green-white gem.
wears: A belt of rough leather with a pouch.
holds: It holds exactly one glowing gem the size of a fist held up in its left hand; its right hand is a clawed fist.
pose: Seen exactly from the side in full profile, like a figure on a coin, facing left: its one huge eye glows yellow at the front of its brow, above the top of its long muzzle, its floppy ear hanging behind, its iron teeth bared, the gem held out in front of it.
must_show: a hound head with a long dog muzzle and a floppy ear, seen in profile
one huge glowing eye at the front of its brow
horse hind legs ending in hooves
a glowing gem held out in one hand
must_not_show: eyes at the sides of the head
action: It stalks forward on its two horse legs, bent forward, the glowing gem held out ahead of it.

what: the waq-waq tree of the Arabic wonder-books: a strange tree with a twisted dark trunk whose branches end in fruit shaped like human heads and animal heads, about seven of them, each one big, each mouth open crying out.
colours: a dark brown twisted trunk, green leaves, the heads pale tan and brown like ripe fruit with dark open mouths. No blue.
holds: It is a tree and holds nothing.
pose: The whole tree shown from its crown down to its roots, its branches spread wide, every head on the branches crying out, nothing beneath its roots.
must_show: a tree whose branches end in heads
the heads crying out with open mouths

what: the yuki-onna, the snow woman of Japan: a tall pale woman with realistic adult proportions, skin as white as snow, very long straight black hair streaming in a blizzard, in a plain white kimono, breathing out one short stream of icy white breath.
colours: snow-white skin, long straight black hair, a white kimono with a pale grey sash, pale icy blue breath, dark eyes, pale lips.
wears: A plain white kimono with a pale grey sash; bare feet.
holds: It holds exactly nothing: her right hand is reaching forward, her left at her side.
pose: Seen from the front, floating forward with her feet off the ground, her hair and sleeves streaming in the wind behind her, one short jet of icy breath from her lips no longer than her head.
must_show: a pale woman in a white kimono

what: the yacumama, the mother of the waters: an immense dark green anaconda, a real snake with one head, its thick coiled body piled in loops, its head raised high, glowing yellow eyes, jaws wide open, a swirl of mist and leaves being drawn into its mouth.
colours: dark olive-green scales with black oval blotches, a pale yellow belly, glowing yellow eyes, a pink mouth, grey mist, green leaves.
holds: It is a snake and holds nothing.
pose: Its coils piled in loops with nothing beneath them, its head reared up high, jaws wide open, mist and leaves swirling into its mouth.
must_show: mist and leaves drawn into its mouth

what: a tsuchigumo, the earth spider of Japan: a giant hairy spider, a real spider drawn large, with eight thick tiger-striped legs in yellow and black, a round hairy brown body, and a fierce demon-like face on its head with fangs, as in an old Japanese scroll painting.
colours: hairy brown body, yellow and black tiger-striped legs, a dark red demon face with white fangs, yellow eyes, white silk. No green.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; a thick strand of white web streams from its jaws.
pose: Seen from the front and a little above, its eight legs spread wide, its body raised, fangs bared.
must_show: a giant spider with eight striped legs

what: a relic guardian of ancient India: a tall statue of a warrior made of bronze and dark teak wood, carved with Indian temple ornament, with four arms, each hand holding a curved sword, standing on a short round carved plinth. Its face is a calm carved bronze mask.
colours: burnished bronze and dark brown teak, gold trim, four steel-grey curved swords, a dark grey stone plinth. No green, no blue.
wears: A carved bronze crown and bronze armour carved like jewellery.
holds: It holds exactly four curved swords, one in each of its four hands, held out at different angles.
pose: Seen from the front, standing on its short round plinth, its four arms spread out with the swords as if spinning, one blade high, one low on each side.
must_show: a bronze and wood statue warrior with four arms
a curved sword in each hand
a carved round plinth under its feet

what: a re'em of the Hebrew Bible: a colossal wild aurochs, a real wild ox on four legs, black-brown with a pale stripe down its back, massive shoulders as high as a hill, and huge forward-sweeping pale horns. A small human figure, a boy, clings to one of its horns for scale.
colours: black-brown coat, a pale grey-tan stripe along its spine, pale cream horns with dark tips, dark eyes. No orange.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing; a tiny boy in a brown tunic clings to its horn.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, all four legs planted, head lowered with the great horns forward, about to charge.
must_show: a colossal wild ox on four legs
a tiny boy clinging to a horn for scale

what: eitr, the first poison of Norse myth: a low, wide, spreading mound of thick black-green venom that flows over itself like tar, crusted with white frost and lumps of grey slag-like ice, with a few thick tendrils of venom reaching out to the left and pale cold steam rising from it; it is a puddle-like mass with no body shape at all.
colours: glossy black-green venom, white frost, pale grey ice slag, a faint pale green steam. No blue.
holds: It is a liquid mass and holds nothing.
pose: Caught surging forward to the left, low and wide, much wider than it is tall, tendrils reaching out, nothing beneath it.
must_show: a low wide mound of black-green venom

what: the bakunawa of Visayan myth: a colossal dark sea serpent with a single horn on its head, gills and long whiskers, its body coiling up in great loops, its huge red mouth wide open, reaching up toward a pale moon held in its jaws.
colours: dark purple-black scales, a lighter grey belly, a red mouth, a white horn, a pale cream moon, red eyes.
holds: It is a serpent and holds nothing; a pale round moon sits in its open jaws.
pose: Its coils rising in great loops with nothing beneath them, its head reared high, its jaws closing round a pale moon.
must_show: a pale moon in its open red jaws
